About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London
 About The Role
 Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated. Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet.
Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web.
AI Search (internal data), now generally available, is the search primitive for applications and agents. It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on Workers AI, Vectorize, R2, and Browser Run. Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs.
Web Search API (external data), now in open beta, gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on AI Gateway, so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as model inference. Developers can choose from multiple search providers and always get results back in one normalized format.
Your mission in this role is to make Cloudflare the default place developers and agents go to search, across both their own data and the open web, and eventually in a single call. You’ll also help build a search ecosystem that works for AI companies, site owners, and creators alike.

Description
 Sr. Product Manager, IN Prime Acquisitions
How often have you had an opportunity to build the acquisition growth engine for Prime - one of the largest and loved subscription programs in India? We are looking for someone who is passionate and obsessed about customers, understands their needs and is looking for opportunities to build world class products that will help customers join Prime and get the best of benefits across shopping, shipping, entertainment, music and more. If you are someone who thrives in ambiguity, and balances dive deep with high judgement, looking around the corners to invent around constraints - we have the role for you. The Senior Product Manager for India Prime Acquisitions will manage and define the end to end roadmap of who, how and when we upsell Prime to customers on the Amazon app. Not only will the role play a defining role in devising the growth strategy for Prime in India, the role is expected to influence other worldwide locales with worldwide first innovations.
In this context, India Prime is looking for an experienced Product leader for Prime member Acquisitions. You will lead the product vision ,strategy and own the product portfolio for this business in India. You will deliver a multi-year product charter for renewals across different plans and channels. Role offers an exciting intellectual opportunity to solve for multiple whitespaces and steer your career pace as we scale.
 Responsibilities
 Responsible for defining a customer insight , data driven product vision, roadmap , write BRDs, user stories , technical design reviews, prioritizing and executing in a high expectation environment.
 Work with technology (IN and global) to build exceptional products. Anticipating bottlenecks, independently drive tradeoffs decisions balancing business needs versus technical or operational constraints.
 Collaborate/influence various stakeholders at multiple levels , local/global , functions- tech, UX, Marketing , Legal , Finance , Machine Learnings, Data sciences, Amazon wide business teams.
 Own reporting to leadership through launch announcements, monthly updates, status updates.
 Develop the long-term strategy for your portfolio, aligning it to the goals of the organization and translate them into an achievable multi – year roadmap.

 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

A Product Manager drives the design, development, and implementation of products based on user needs and the company's product strategy and vision. A Product Manager is deeply committed to solving user (e.g. customer or partner) pain points and identifying opportunities to improve their experience. A Product Manager primarily works within their team and other teams within the same department. A Product Manager typically leads a single development team and deals with a relatively narrow scope and limited set of cross-functional stakeholders.
Products/features owned by a Product Manager achieve meaningful impact within the context of their department. In an optimisation setting, this might mean achieving meaningful incremental performance. In an NPD setting, this may mean successfully validating new concepts that lead to relevant and meaningful new business investments. Product Managers participate in the wider product community, for instance attending or giving talks about product craft.

 Product Strategy
 Owns and sets the vision for their product/feature, informed by data, user research and overarching vision of their product area
 Lays out a 1y strategy to achieve the vision, as part of their Department's strategy and is able to align all their key stakeholders inc. their team on this strategy

About The Team
 We are building a standalone LLM-powered product at Monee. It covers document understanding, information extraction, verification, fraud detection and review automation for financial services across SEA. These capabilities already serve several internal businesses, but today they are embedded inside other products such as User Center and AIMOS. We are looking for a senior PM to turn them into an independent product. It will serve internal teams and be sold to external B2B clients as API services and private / on-premise deployments, with ongoing iteration after delivery.
 Job Description
 Product strategy & roadmap: Own the vision, positioning and roadmap of the LLM product line. Define product boundaries, module structure and versioning. Lead the decoupling of existing capabilities from User Center, AIMOS and other systems into a standalone, reusable service.
 Productization: “simple outside, complex inside”: Design clean external interfaces (APIs, SDKs, admin console, standardized output schemas with confidence scores, human-review workflows). Keep the hard parts, such as model selection, prompt and post-processing logic, and edge-case handling, inside the product and the algorithm layer, so clients can integrate with minimal effort.
 B2B delivery models: Design and standardize offerings across SaaS API, private / on-premise deployment and hybrid modes. This includes packaging, hardware and GPU sizing, SLA, licensing, data isolation and security, model upgrade and iteration delivery, and long-term support and maintenance services.
 Translate business problems into modelling tasks: Work with Data Science to define tasks, evaluation sets, acceptance criteria and business metrics, such as field-level accuracy, straight-through processing rate, manual review rate, fraud catch rate, latency and cost per document. Make informed trade-offs between quality, latency and cost.
 Judge LLM capability boundaries: Understand what current LLMs / VLMs can and cannot do reliably. Decide where model capability is enough, where rules, verification or human-in-the-loop are needed, and design fallbacks and risk controls. Make sure every proposed solution is technically feasible and deliverable.
 Cross-functional leadership: Drive alignment and execution across Engineering, Algorithm, Risk, Operations, Legal / Compliance and clients. Make decisions and push them through, and push back on unreasonable or infeasible requirements.
 Documentation & standards: Produce high-quality PRDs, API documentation, deployment and integration guides, solution proposals and release notes. Establish product delivery and acceptance standards.
 Product operations: Track usage, quality, cost and revenue metrics. Build dashboards and drive continuous optimization based on data and client feedback.
 Requirements
 irements
 Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.
 3+ years of product management experience, including 1+ years on AI / ML / LLM products or ToB platform, API or SaaS products.
 Proven 0→1 experience building a B2B or platform product. Experience with private / on-premise delivery is a strong plus.
 Solid understanding of how LLMs / VLMs work and where they fall short: prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, hallucination, evaluation methodology, inference cost and latency, GPU resource constraints. Able to discuss technical options with algorithm engineers as a peer and read evaluation reports critically.
